text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right before training,
Matikanefukukitaru calls
me to the
academy library. It's pitch black inside.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Welcome, welcome! You are
the first
lucky wayward lamb to visit
me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Argh! My eyes! Why did you turn the
lights on?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I put in a lot of work to set the mood...
You've
gone and ruined it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aiyee, you're jumping straight to the
point?!
You're that interested in what I
have for you?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But of course you are! Well you see, I'd
like to
include you in my fortune-telling
session today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm calling it "Trainer
Divination"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's simple—all you've got to do is pick a
card.
The type of card will reveal to us
the outcome of
today's training session!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Come now, there are three cards on the
desk.
Pick whichever one you like!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If you could, pick the great fortune one!
Pretty
please...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru's eyes are twinkling
more
than usual. Hm, which card should I
choose?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Is that your final answer? Then let's turn
it over
and take a look!
choice_data_list: 真ん中の怪しげなカード

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flip...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Would you look at that! It's a
picture of a
cheetah with a belly full of
food!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The cheetah is the symbol of speed. And
there's
nothing better than eating to
your heart's
content!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
An omen of fortune is an omen of
fortune. Luck
will surely come our way!
Something good,
happen to us, please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In our training session after,
Matikanefukukitaru
achieves a new
personal best lap time.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Would you look at that! It's a person
grasping a
flame high in the air!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
These blazing flames symbolize victory.
In other
words, I'm going to seize hold of
something that
will bode good
prospects!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I don't know why, but I'm pumped up
and ready
to go! Let's hit the track
running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She goes above and beyond in our
training
session after, grasping some sort
of new
technique in the process.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Eek! This picture... Isn't that the
you-know-who
that carries the scythe?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Training's cancelled today! It's an
absolute no-no
for me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This means the absolute worst! The
apocalypse,
plagues, hopelessness,
large-scale heartbreak, a
supernova...
Uuughhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I manage to get Matikanefukukitaru to
do some
training, but she's totally
lacking in energy...
